title: Sandisolar SD 11KP48V WIFI beta.4 support archive
summary: A beta.4 support archive captured the exact Modbus fingerprint layout 4 and model code 0x8003 for a Sandisolar SD 11KP48V WIFI reported as an ANJ-11KW-compatible inverter. The live values at registers 227 and 231 follow the documented protocol-4 frequency and temperature layout rather than the generic SMG layout.
